f17r.name: Plant
f17r.looks: Three dark blue flower heads on green cups, a tall green stem with long narrow green leaves in pairs, and a fine brown root with red marks.

f17v.name: Plant
f17v.looks: A green stem arching over the top with clusters of small red berries and a curling tendril, broad green leaves down the right, and a long hairy tan root lying along the bottom.

f18r.name: Plant
f18r.looks: One large blue flower with a red centre and three small buds on top of an upright green stem with broad green leaves, over a spreading brown root.

f18v.name: Plant
f18v.looks: A round flower head of scales and fringe with red dots in its centre, a branched green stem with lobed green leaves, and a thick tan root spreading sideways into flame-like lobes and a curled tail.

f19r.name: Plant
f19r.looks: A dark blue flower with a pale rim, small blue-and-white flower clusters, toothed green leaves on a thin stem, two large drooping green fronds, and a tan root rising into a cup-shaped top.

f19v.name: Plant
f19v.looks: Three small dark blue flowers on thin stalks above two dense tufts of green foliage on a pale green stem, which rises from a brownish-red root with spreading legs.

f20r.name: Plant
f20r.looks: Several upright stalks with rows of small green leaflets, red leaflets and blue buds at the tips, over a pale tan root.

f20v.name: Plant
f20v.looks: A green stem with branching stalks ending in fringed flower heads with dark blue tops, long narrow green leaves bound in bunches across the stems, and a pale tan root at the bottom.

f21r.name: Plant
f21r.looks: Many green branches spreading out like a star from a dense centre, lined with small green leaves and strings of tan beads, over thin brown roots.

f21v.name: Plant
f21v.looks: Blue flowers with red tips on thin pale branching stalks, long leaves made of curved green segments on both sides of the stem, and a brown looped root at the bottom.

f22r.name: Plant
f22r.looks: Three dark blue round flower heads at the top, a fan of pale stalks carrying strings of small red-and-white beads, round green leaves with pale edges, pale paired stems and a spreading red-brown root.

f22v.name: Plant
f22v.looks: A large pale closed flower with a blue and gold top on a tall thin stem, long green leaves made of many curved strips, and a thick red-brown thorny root curled round with white rings.

f23r.name: Plant
f23r.looks: Two leafy stems, each rising from a pale cup, with many hand-shaped green leaves and small blue flowers at the tops, standing on one long log-like tan root with thin roots below.

f23v.name: Plant
f23v.looks: A blue star-shaped flower with a round centre on top, a dense crown of rounded green and olive leaves, two lower clusters of leaves with small blue flowers, a pale stem and a spreading red-brown root.

f24r.name: Plant
f24r.looks: Two tall stems with large pale daisy-like flowers held under hooded green tops, many small curled green leaves, the stems twisting together at the base into long pale wavy roots.

f24v.name: Plant
f24v.looks: Four dark blue flowers in pale cups on curving stalks, round green leaves with long pointed tails along a pale stem, and a bunch of tapering brown roots.
